# Design point P008

## Description

The system would deploy GVFS without the cache-server infrastructure needed to support sufficiently large repositories, while requiring each repository write to acquire an exclusive majority lock. This provides a majority-based safeguard against conflicting writes, but the lack of cache infrastructure may limit scalability or suitability for large repositories.
